about.heading: Dedicated to the Sacred Service of Gau Mata
about.historyText: Shree Nagnath Gauseva Trust was founded with the sacred mission of protecting and serving cows. Located in Ishvariya, Gujarat, we provide shelter, food, and medical care to abandoned, injured, sick, and old cows who have nowhere else to go.
about.missionText: To provide a safe, loving home for every abandoned, sick, and injured cow, ensuring they receive the best possible care, nutrition, and medical treatment throughout their lives.
about.visionText: A world where no cow is left wandering on roads hungry or injured — where every Gau Mata is treated with the respect and love she deserves.

campaign.heading: Emergency: Feed Shortage Crisis
campaign.description: This year's drought has caused a severe shortage of green fodder and hay. Feed prices have skyrocketed, and we are struggling to provide adequate nutrition to our 500+ cows. Without your immediate help, many of our beloved cows may go hungry.

services.heading: Our Services
services.subheading: Dedicated service for the welfare and protection of Gau Mata
services.shelterDesc: Providing a safe, clean, and loving home for abandoned and wandering cows. Our spacious gaushala ensures every cow lives with comfort and dignity.
services.medicalDesc: Complete veterinary care including surgeries, vaccinations, wound treatment, and regular health checkups by experienced veterinarians.
services.feedingDesc: Nutritious meals including green fodder, dry hay, cattle feed, and clean drinking water served to every cow, every single day.
services.rescueDesc: 24/7 rescue service for injured, sick, or abandoned cows found on roads, accident sites, and dangerous locations across the region.
services.oldCareDesc: Special dedicated care for elderly and chronically ill cows who need extra attention, medicines, and gentle handling.
services.productsDesc: Producing organic fertilizer from cow dung, promoting gobar gas, and practicing sustainable agriculture to support our operations.
